headline: Binance is aiming to reopen withdrawals on Sunday and publish full Proof of Reserves on Monday, as Friday's tech sell-off dragged bitcoin toward a second straight losing October.

market.asOf: Read from CoinDesk's live blog at 3:24pm ET Fri 30 Oct (19:24 UTC, 02:24 Bangkok Sat) and Yahoo Finance's live blog at about 3:27pm ET, before the US close, not a live price page: CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap and the Fear & Greed index could not be read reliably this run. Check the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: Not read this run: the index page could not be opened reliably.

stories.title: Binance targets Sunday to reopen withdrawals, Monday for full Proof of Reserves
stories.summary: Co-CEO Richard Teng said Binance hopes to restart withdrawals within about 40 hours, and is targeting Sunday, but only once the rebuilt system passes testing. A full Proof of Reserves report (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is promised by Monday.
points: Binance puts the theft at about $6.3B; Chainalysis' Jonathan Levin puts it at $6.4B. Binance says more than $6.34B is set aside to cover it, per Cointelegraph.
About $3B of the stolen funds has been frozen, including about $1.567B of USDT by Tether, per Cointelegraph.
CoinDesk found the drained wallets were among those backing customer balances: about 204,500 ETH was taken, roughly 5.6% of Binance's ETH reserves.
CFTC Chair Michael Selig told CNBC blockchain tracing gives 'a very good shot' at following the funds, and said 'the real issue here is that these are unregulated offshore exchanges', per Stocktwits.

stories.title: Tech sell-off deepens into the close, and bitcoin heads for a losing October
stories.summary: The Binance hack landed on the same day as a sharp drop in tech stocks, and both pulled crypto lower through the US afternoon. These are intraday readings from before the 4pm ET close.
points: Late in the session the Nasdaq Composite was down 3.3%, the Dow down 1.25% at 3:27pm ET and Intel down about 30%, per Yahoo Finance.
Bitcoin was about $76,300 at 3:24pm ET and down about 8.4% for October, per CoinDesk, which would make it a second losing October in a row.
At the open Coinbase fell 12%, Strategy 11%, Circle 9.5%, Bullish 8.3% and Galaxy 6.8%, per CoinDesk.
Some analysts pushed back on the panic: Cantor's Ramsey El-Assal said 'this is painful, but it is not 2022', per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Weak results also weighed on Coinbase and Strategy
stories.summary: The two biggest US-listed crypto companies reported on Thursday, and their results were soft before the hack hit: Coinbase's trading revenue shrank sharply, and Strategy announced its finance chief is leaving.
points: Coinbase's transaction revenue fell 44% from a year earlier to $590M, per 24/7 Wall St.
Sources differ on total revenue: 24/7 Wall St says $1.16B against $1.21B expected; Benzinga says $1.216B against $1.230B expected.
Strategy CFO Andrew Kang steps down on 5 Nov for personal reasons, which the company says was not the result of any disagreement, per CoinDesk.
Strategy reported holding 848,517 BTC, per the company.

briefs.title: Tether reports $1.5B Q3 profit
briefs.summary: Tether's excess reserves rose to $7.95B from $4.11B in June, with total reserves of $191.45B.

briefs.title: Ether ETFs lose $105.5M
briefs.summary: On 29 Oct US spot ether ETFs saw $105.5M of outflows and solana ETFs $27.7M, while bitcoin ETFs took in a small inflow.

briefs.title: Liquidations top $1.6B
briefs.summary: More than $1.6B of leveraged positions were wiped out, $1.35B of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data.

briefs.title: Hacker swaps about $158M of altcoins for ETH
briefs.summary: The attacker sold UNI, ENA, PEPE, LINK, AAVE and others for 70,480 ETH; some analysts question Binance's 'no key leak' account.

briefs.title: Coinbase bitcoin price falls to a deep discount
briefs.summary: Bitcoin traded at a deep discount on Coinbase compared with Binance, which suggests weaker buying or stronger selling there, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Monthly options expire
briefs.summary: About $10.9B of bitcoin options expired on Deribit at 08:00 UTC Friday, with max pain at $78K.

briefs.title: Aave reopens its markets
briefs.summary: Aave reopened its V3 and V4 markets after a precautionary freeze and says it was not affected by the hack.
